subject.title: Rainbow Municipal Water District Board, Division 3

text: I previously served as the Director representing District One on the Rainbow Municipal Water District Board, where I worked to promote informed decision-making, public education, and responsible water management. I also completed the Citizens Water Academy, strengthening my understanding of California water resources, infrastructure, conservation, and the challenges facing local water agencies. My professional background gives me a practical perspective on the issues before the District. I am a licensed California Real Estate Broker and own an independent brokerage specializing in complex transactions, investment properties, and agricultural land. Earlier in my career, I served as National Sales Manager for a major title insurance company, developing industry marketing programs throughout Southern California, and taught investment analysis courses at Orange Coast College. Through my experience in water governance, real estate, agriculture, finance and education, I understand how water policy affects residents, property owners, agricultural users, land use and the long-term vitality of our community. I will bring careful judgment, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and a commitment to serving the public with integrity.
